title: cornus alba var. gouchaultii
intro: Cornus alba var. gouchaultii, commonly known as the Red Osier Dogwood, is a deciduous shrub native to Asia, known for its striking red stems and vibrant white flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cornus alba var. gouchaultii include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular-protective effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. These bioactive compounds have been shown to exert therapeutic actions by inhibiting oxidative stress, reducing inflammation, and modulating the immune system, highlighting the potential of Cornus alba var. gouchaultii as a valuable medicinal plant.
